end.geocode_source: Nominatim query 'Wuxuan County, Guangxi, China' (OSM relation 2775861, county-level; no finer station or township was sourced for the Wuxuan side of this segment)

corridor_notes: GEM row = Laibin Branch, Xingbin-Wuxuan Segment (广西天然气支线管网项目来宾天然气支线管道工程（兴宾-武宣段）), operator Guangxi Gas Group, under construction. Sina News (k.sina.com.cn, 2022-12-20, verified) reports the groundbreaking ceremony for the wider Laibin branch (来宾天然气支线管道工程暨三江口新区天然气管道项目) took place at Liumian village (刘冕村), Chengxiang town (城厢镇), Xingbin District, on National Highway 314 -- village-level precision, but Liumian village itself did not resolve in Nominatim, so the town centroid is used as the plotted start point. The same article describes the overall Laibin-branch route as Laibin distribution station -> Xingbin -> Wuxuan -> Xiangzhou -> Jinxiu, pipe OD 273.1mm, 4.0MPa design pressure. Laibin Daily (epaper.lbnews.com.cn, 2023-08-09, verified) separately confirms the EIA for this EXACT sub-segment (兴宾-武宣段) was completed and open for public comment, developer Guangxi Gas Group -- confirming the segment terminates in Wuxuan County, but without naming a specific Wuxuan-side station or township. A separate 2019-era dnr.gxzf.gov.cn land-use approval (t19512609, unreachable/unverified this session) additionally names Nansi Township (南泗乡) and Mengcun Town (蒙村镇) within Xingbin District as land crossed by the '兴宾段' (Xingbin portion) of this same project -- consistent context, not used as a cited ref since the page itself is unreachable.
researcher_notes: Pilot pass already flagged a Diameter spec concern (GEM records a bare 250mm while every independent source gives 273.1mm OD) -- out of scope for this route-creation task, noted for the parallel validity-fix workstream. The groundbreaking-ceremony location (Chengxiang town) is a reasonable proxy for a route start point but is not itself confirmed as the literal pipeline terminus/station -- flagging as a caveat for the human router.
blockers: Wuxuan-side endpoint is sourced only to county granularity -- no station/township-level document was found or reachable this session (the analogous dnr.gxzf.gov.cn land-use filing for the '武宣段' portion, mirroring the Xingbin-side t19512609 filing, was not located before the WebSearch budget was exhausted).
